description: Covers events in Türkiye (Turkey) only. Searches current listings on biseyvarmi.com from a plain question in Turkish or English, e.g. "Kadıköy'de bu hafta sonu konser", "tiyatro Ankara yarın", "Hamlet İstanbul", "kids events in Beşiktaş this weekend". Reads the place (city or district), the kind of event (konser, tiyatro, stand-up, sergi, festival, çocuk…) and the time (bugün, yarın, bu hafta sonu); the rest is searched as a title, performer or venue. Returns up to 10 events with ids; an id can be passed to fetch for dates, venues and prices.

query.description: The question, in Turkish or English.

name: search
title: Ask about events
